_source: Instruction: task statement quoted from Mtumbuka & Schockaert (2024) Section 3 (p. 6005). Inventory: the paper's WIKIDATA_RELATION_TYPES (352 = 351 Wikidata properties + P0; fmtumbuka/RelationEmbeddings@66d3c9a experiment/__init__.py), identical to the labels of the held-out file. Keys: the dataset's 2016 property labels (UKPLab/emnlp2017-relation-extraction@77bfd94 resources/properties-with-labels.txt) + PID. Descriptions: Wikidata English property descriptions (wbgetentities, 2026-09-26); P7, P9, P134, P450, P1962 were deleted from Wikidata after 2016, their descriptions are from 2016 Wayback snapshots of their property pages. P0 description quoted from Sorokin & Gurevych (2017) Section 3 (p. 1785). P0 is never offered directly: >255 labels exceed the choice cap, so round 1 asks two fixed halves (numeric PID order, 176/175) each with the 'none_option', round 2 asks between the two half winners (see src/gauntlet/tasks/relemb.py).

none_option.description: None of the relations listed in this question holds from the head entity to the tail entity.
